# Tech Velocity

> Tech Velocity (T3CH VELOCITY, LLC) builds private, custom AI systems for small and mid-sized businesses. We train models on each client's own data and workflows — not generic tools — covering workflow automation, AI-powered email triage, business intelligence dashboards, AI sales training, and industry-specific AI for legal, healthcare, insurance, engineering, financial services, real estate, and professional services firms.

Every engagement starts with a free 45-minute AI Discovery Audit. There is no fixed price list: each build is scoped and quoted based on what the business needs. Typical delivery is 2–5 weeks with 30–60 days of post-launch support, team training, and ongoing retraining options. Client data is never used to train models for other clients; proprietary models run in isolated environments.

Contact: hello@techvelocity.ai · +1 833-533-0225 · https://techvelocity.ai/contact

## Frequently asked questions

**Do I need technical knowledge to work with you?** Not at all. You tell us what your business does and where the pain is; we handle everything technical. Clients are business owners and operations leads, not engineers.

**What makes a custom AI model better than ChatGPT?** Public AI tools are trained on generic internet data and don't know your products, clients, or compliance rules. A model trained on your specific data gives accurate, consistent outputs matched to your standards.

**How long does it take to build and deploy?** Starter systems are typically live within 2 weeks. Growth packages run 3–5 weeks. Enterprise timelines are scoped during discovery.

**Is my business data safe and private?** Yes. NDAs are signed before discovery work begins, client data is never used to train models for other clients, and proprietary models run in isolated environments.

**What industries do you serve?** Healthcare, legal, insurance, financial services, engineering, manufacturing, real estate, and professional services — any business with data and repeatable processes.

**What happens after the AI is deployed?** A monitoring period tracks performance and catches edge cases. Support windows run 30–60 days depending on plan, with ongoing retraining available.

**What ROI can I realistically expect?** Most clients recoup their investment within 60–90 days through time savings alone, with 70–80% reduction in manual processing time being a common outcome.

**Can you integrate with the software I already use?** Yes — CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), project management tools (Asana, Monday), communication platforms (Slack, Teams), ERPs, and any tool with an API or spreadsheet export.

**Do you train my team to use the AI?** Yes, every deployment includes a structured handover, team training session, documentation, and a dedicated support window.
